info.title: ReleaseGen
info.description: Opinionated .NET CLI for building, packaging, and publishing .NET projects, with cross-platform packaging targets and project-file-prioritized build settings.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Opinionated .NET CLI for building, packaging, and publishing .NET projects.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress stage notes and progress. Warnings and errors stay visible. [default: False]

commands.name: init
commands.description: Writes a minimal valid releasegen.json manifest.

options.name: --preset
options.description: Seed the manifest's build.preset key with a known preset name. Use 'none' or omit the flag for no preset.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Replace releasegen.json when it already exists in the current directory. [default: False]

commands.name: build
commands.description: Builds release binaries for the manifest's targets.

options.name: --preset
options.description: Override the manifest's build.preset for this invocation only. Does not write the manifest.

commands.name: test
commands.description: Runs dotnet test on the manifest's test projects.

commands.name: package
commands.description: Packages each target's declared artefact kinds.

commands.name: publish
commands.description: Publishes each target's declared package kinds to the configured NuGet sources.

options.name: --api-key
options.description: The NuGet API key. Falls back to the NUGET_API_KEY environment variable. Never read from the manifest.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Runs the manifest's stages in manifest order (chained run).

options.name: --preset
options.description: Override the manifest's build.preset for this invocation only. Does not write the manifest.
